name: Quality of earnings adjustment evidence schedule
summary: When management proposes adjustments to a target's EBITDA, the deal team gets one schedule: each adjustment tied to its ledger entries, explanation and documents, with repeats, overlaps and gaps flagged and every gap written as a question. The engagement lead decides what is accepted.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of the work, written from how deal teams tie a target's proposed earnings adjustments to the ledger, management's explanations and supporting documents. No third-party text.
